Find games to report on

Source: R/report.R
euroleague_games.Rd

euroleague_games() lists a EuroLeague season's games with the game code that fetch_game() and match_report() need. nba_games() lists the NBA games on a date with ESPN's game id.

Usage

euroleague_games(season, team = NULL, played_only = TRUE)

nba_games(date)

Arguments

season

EuroLeague season start year (2026 = 2026/27).

team

Optional team code (e.g. "OLY") to keep only its games.

played_only

Keep only games already played.

date

A date ("2025-06-22" or a Date).

Value

A tibble: game (code or id), date, round (EuroLeague), home, away, home_name, away_name, home_score, away_score.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tail(euroleague_games(2026, team = "OLY"))   # Olympiacos's latest games
nba_games("2025-06-22")                       # NBA Finals Game 7
} # }
